texts: On day 34 of Year 1, the harvest party returned to Cauldron Hall at dawn with twelve full buckets of salt-bloom.
Hesper poured the salt-bloom into the salt-bloom store.
Hesper labeled each compartment of the store with the date.

sentences: On day 34 of Year 1, the harvest party returned to Cauldron Hall at dawn with twelve full buckets of salt-bloom.
Hesper poured the salt-bloom into the salt-bloom store.
Hesper labeled each compartment of the store with the date.
parse: (: s4_label_rule (Implication (And (PartOf $x sk_store_1) (Member $x compartment)) (And (Member (sk_label $x) label) (Agent (sk_label $x) hesper) (Patient (sk_label $x) $x) (Instrument (sk_label $x) sk_date_1) (Past (sk_label $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: (Instrument sk_return_1 sk_bucket_1) claims the buckets were the means by which the returning was performed; they are carried cargo, which the with-phrase test (CoAgent = animate participant, Instrument = means) does not cover.
(LocatedIn sk_salt_bloom_1 sk_bucket_1) reads containment off an "of"-partitive, though LocatedIn is licensed only for the containment prepositions in / at / inside / within.

q2_gaps: an inanimate accompaniment / cargo "with"-phrase ("returned ... with twelve full buckets") — the with-phrase split offers only CoAgent (animate co-participant) or Instrument (means), neither of which fits
a container/measure partitive ("twelve full buckets of salt-bloom") — excluded from the genitive rules as a measure, but given no positive encoding for the container-contents link or the amount

tense on a prenominal adjectival modifier distributed to a group's members ("twelve full buckets" → (Past (Member $x full)) at statement 14) — the wrapping rule covers copular clauses and appositives, not prenominal modifiers
review.notes: "The salt-bloom stayed potent" (31-35) follows the continuation-copular pattern exactly, and the "each compartment of the store" universal is a correct per-member rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion and no group event. Both defects come from the same unencodable "twelve full buckets of salt-bloom" phrase.

issues.reason: Thematic roles define Instrument as the means the event is performed by (a tool, substance or conduit) and split a with-phrase only into participant-CoAgent vs means-Instrument, so calling the carried buckets the means of the returning asserts a manner of return the sentence never states - exactly the mis-slotting the section's 'decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest' bars.

'twelve full buckets OF salt-bloom' states the containment itself rather than leaving it to world knowledge, and LocatedIn is the instruction set's containment head; the 'in / at / inside / within' clause bars folding NON-containment prepositions (on / under / beside) into LocatedIn, not a stated containment, so in this acknowledged measure-partitive gap the atom is true of the sentence's content and well-typed.

gaps_confirmed: no licensed slot for an inanimate accompaniment / cargo 'with'-phrase ('returned ... with twelve full buckets'): the with-split offers only CoAgent (animate co-participant) or Instrument (means), and neither fits carried cargo

no positive encoding for a container / measure partitive ('twelve full buckets of salt-bloom'): Possessive / genitive NP explicitly excludes the measure of-phrase ('a cup of water') and no section supplies the container-contents link or the amount reading
new_gaps: the content 'with'-phrase of a marking verb ('labeled each compartment with the date') has the same hole as the cargo case: the date is the inscribed content, not the means by which the labeling was done, and neither CoAgent nor Instrument names it - this parse's (Instrument (sk_label $x) sk_date_1) is the near-fit that results

the continuation-copular recipe ('the lodge remained / stayed empty' -> reified state + Still + the flat atom + tense) does not say whether the past tense wraps the flat atom, as the copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit explicitly does; this parse emits a bare, present-reading (Member sk_salt_bloom_1 potent) beside (Past sk_potent_1)
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form omits (Instrument sk_return_1 sk_bucket_1) and carries the cargo phrase at most as the surface-preposition oblique (With sk_return_1 sk_bucket_1) if the 'head is the preposition actually used' licence reaches past the CoAgent/Instrument split; since that split is stated as exhaustive for with-phrases, no form is licensed for inanimate cargo accompaniment and the adjunct must be left out with the gap recorded.
adjudication.notes: Reviewer gap 3 is not a gap: 'the surface tense decides, mechanically ... it wraps every categorical atom the clause yields' plus the plural distributive rule together license (Past (Member $x full)) for 'twelve full buckets'. The rest of the parse is clean - the singular-collective 'harvest party' takes a plain event with no distribution, the 'each compartment of the store' universal is a correct PartOf-ranged rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and 'poured ... into the store' takes the motion-result Goal with no Result atom.
